products.name: Hybrid Identity with Active Directory & Microsoft Entra Connect — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish solid hybrid identity with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra Connect — reliable synchronization, the right authentication method, hybrid Entra join, and health monitoring. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
One identity, on-prem and in the cloud — synchronized, secured, and reliable

Most organizations still run Active Directory on-premises while their apps, devices, and security live in the cloud. If the bridge between them is misconfigured, you get duplicate accounts, broken sign-ins, and devices that won't join properly. This solution establishes solid hybrid identity with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra Connect — reliable synchronization, the right authentication method (password hash sync, pass-through authentication, or federation), hybrid Entra join, and the health monitoring to keep it that way.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the hybrid identity model, Microsoft Entra Connect (Connect Sync vs. Cloud Sync), authentication methods (PHS, PTA, federation), seamless SSO, hybrid Entra join, and synchronization health.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Active Directory, Entra ID licensing, an Entra Connect host, the authentication method decision, UPN/domain hygiene, network) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: prepare AD and domains, install and configure Entra Connect, choose and enable the authentication method, scope synchronization, enable hybrid Entra join, validate sign-in and sync health, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — AD/identity readiness discovery, synchronization and sign-in validation, a sync-health and object-coverage report, safe remediation of sync errors/duplicates (-WhatIf default), and a sync-scope helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

One reliable identity spanning Active Directory and Entra ID — synchronized cleanly, authenticated by the right method, with hybrid join and healthy sync — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • HYBID-Discovery.ps1 — Active Directory and identity readiness for hybrid identity
    • HYBID-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix sync errors and duplicate UPN/proxyAddress values
    • HYBID-Report.ps1 — synchronization health and object-coverage report
    • HYBID-Set-SyncScopeHelper.ps1 — review and stage organizational-unit sync-scope changes
    • HYBID-Validation.ps1 — confirm synchronization ran and sign-in is working

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
